items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for bounded reversible growth. Concrete evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. TLS evidence only reports no certificates expiring within 30 days and does not establish complete TLS safety. No incident or exploitation is evidenced; retained implementation failures are containment signals only. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates and allow only reversible work that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, deployment, new data collection, or cross-site behavior, while continuing the existing read-only evidence matrix. Do not claim security clearance or a clean bill of health.
